Title: [LSJ] How is the printing errors possible?

Messages.Author: Henrik Klippstr?m
Messages.Body:
I quote from WW Online about the Black Hand set:
"The booster packs were to be all-new. Due to a printing error,
however, the booster packs contain two reprints of previous cards; two
advanced vampires were accidentally replaced with their base
counterparts on the uncommon sheet. One of the advanced vampires is
still to be found in a starter. The other is not found at all in this
set, but will be printed in the upcoming Gehenna set instead. "

My question to LSJ or someone else at WW who wants to answer:
How is these kind of mistakes possible? Don´t you do some kind of
try-runs in printing to check that everything is OK?

This thing, that the whole run of a set is misprinted, is realy common
in collectible card games, not only in VtES, and I don´t have a clue
why. In any other business that deals with print these kind of
mistakes are usualy avoided.

Thanks in advance for any reply. And I love you guys anyway.

silly. Not the same business. Not the same process. Print, edition, that are
domains that are well known and mastered.
When you give you asset for launching the print of something, you usually
sign a kind of colour photography (don't know the exact term in english. In
french, it's a cromalin) that is exactly what you'll get at the end of the
process.

If it has not made this way, it is stupid, and as I don't think that WW
people who have made their business from edition are stupid, the reason why
there is a flaw in the edition is that the try-run given by the printer is
false. In this case, he is responsible.

And he has to pay !

Nagaraja

Messages.Author: Janne Hägglund
Messages.Body:
as...@hotmail.com (Henrik Klippstr?m) writes:

> My question to LSJ or someone else at WW who wants to answer:
> How is these kind of mistakes possible? Don´t you do some kind of
> try-runs in printing to check that everything is OK?

Hey, if they catch a mistake, you won't see it.

Their track record is surprisingly good, considering the mistakes they
*have* caught before printing, like:

- Normal having +2 bleed
- Thoughts Betrayed having no blood cost
- "for the duration/remainder of combat" missing from Aura Reading and Raptor
- pool cost missing from Zillah's Valley
- "Lucky Blow" having X-rated art not related to fighting
- Eyes of the Dead only playable by allies
- "Dominate Kine" printed as "Dominate Caine"
- "burn Leather Jacket to" missing from Leather Jacket
- Husamettin having the picture of Saddam Hussein as art
- "and burn the opposing vampire" mistakenly added to the text of Majesty
- Political Ally accidentally having the text and stats of Renegade Garou
- The Slaughterhouse burning cards from your prey's controlled region
- etc, etc.

So we should really cut them some slack. ;-)
